[[Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur]] | organization = United Phosphorus Limited | spouse = Binota | website = {{URL|http://www.kalyanbanerjee.com/}} }} '''Kalyan Banerjee''' (born 1942) is an Indian humanitarian, who served as the 101st President of [[Rotary International]], for the year 2011–2012. He took office on 1 July 2011 from [[Ray Klinginsmith]].{{cite news |last1=Bhaskar |first1=C Uday |date=1 July 2011 |title=Vapi businessman is Rotary International president |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/money/report_vapi-businessman-is-rotary-international-president_1561174 |newspaper=[[DNA (newspaper)|DNA]] |publisher=Diligent Media Corporation |accessdate=2011-07-01}}{{cite news |date=30 June 2011 |title=Indian technocrat Kalyan Banerjee to lead Rotary as its 101st president |url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/news/indian-technocrat-kalyan-banerjee-to-lead-rotary-as-its-101st-president/441028/ |newspaper=Business Standard |accessdate=2011-07-01}}{{cite web |url=http://www.rotaryfirst100.org/presidents/1997.htm|title=The presidents of Rotary International 1997-98 to 2011-12|last1=|first1=|last2=|first2=|date=|work=Rotary Global History Fellowship (An internet project)|publisher=Rotary Global History Fellowship|accessdate=2011-07-01}} == Career == He is Rotary International's third President from India, the third largest contributor to [[Rotary Foundation|The Rotary Foundation]].{{cite news |date=1 November 2010 |title=Rotary sets itself ambitious target |url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-national/tp-andhrapradesh/rotary-sets-itself-ambitious-target/article862847.ece |work=The Hindu |accessdate=2011-07-02}} He is a director of United Phosphorus Limited, the largest agrochemical manufacturer of India, and the chairman of United Phosphorus ([[Bangladesh]]) Limited. He is a member of the [[Indian Institute of Chemical Engineers]] and the [[American Chemical Society]]. He has been president of Vapi Industries Association and chairman of the Gujarat chapter of the [[Confederation of Indian Industry]] (CII). ==Personal life== Banerjee is based in Vapi. He is married to Binota, and the couple have two children and four grandchildren. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.uplonline.com/ United Phosphorus Limited website] * [https://www.facebook.com/kalyanbanerjeerotary Facebook Profile] {{s-start}} {{succession box | title = [[Rotary International#List of Presidents|President of Rotary International]] | years = 2011-2012 | before = [[Ray Klinginsmith]] | after = [[Sakuji Tanaka]] }} {{s-end}} {{authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Banerjee, Kalyan}} [[Category:Rotary International leaders]] [[Category:1942 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:20th-century Bengali people]] [[Category:21st-century Bengali people]] [[Category:Scindia School alumni]] [[Category:Visva-Bharati University alumni]] [[Category:IIT Kharagpur alumni]] [[Category:Indian chemical engineers]] [[Category:Businesspeople from Gujarat]] [[Category:Businesspeople from Kolkata]]
